observedStructure: Only nonadjacent original segment pairs are tested; first/last adjacent pair is also skipped.
Accepted intersections are inserted into both participating edge split lists; split positions are ordered using float comparison.
Half-edge targets heTo and reverse/from adjacency are constructed. Outgoing half-edges at each node are sorted by atan2f(deltaY,deltaX), using Single.CompareTo.
Unvisited directed half-edge seeds are walked. At each endpoint the successor is outgoing[(indexOfReverse+degree-1)%degree]; visited bytes prevent reprocessing the same directed edge.
A guard caps the half-edge walk. Extracted candidate loops with fewer than3 edges are skipped; each remaining loop is checked for sign.

faceSelection.rule: Only S<0 is passed to EmitFace; S>=0 (including0) is rejected. This selects counterclockwise bounded planar faces and removes the opposite outer face in the examined traversal.
faceSelection.fillMeaning: The examined main routine does not apply original-contour even-odd or winding-number point-in-polygon classification after constructing the planar graph. It renders the positive bounded faces separately. This supports filling every enclosed region once for crossings; the main routine does not compute their combined integer gameplay area.

emitFace.finding: Faces with fewer than3 vertices return. Convex faces use incenter/average-point and inset glow mesh construction; concave faces tail-call EarClipGlowOff. These routines triangulate already selected faces for display; no original-contour interior/exterior filter or gameplay percent is introduced in EmitFace.
emitFace.precisionBoundary: Convexity/inset/ear-clipping implementation details were not expanded further because they affect shader triangulation of selected regions rather than the server gameplay percent.

orderingLambdas.meaning: Split-list tuple comparator compares the float parameter using System.Single.CompareTo.
Outgoing half-edge comparator loads heTo endpoint, subtracts current node pos, obtains atan2f(deltaY,deltaX), and compares the two float angles.

floatAndDegenerateRules.precision: Coordinates, determinants, intersection parameters, squared distances, adjacency atan2f angles and face-sign sums are float32. Vector operations use subps/mulps/hsubps/haddps; scalar arithmetic uses divss/mulss/addss. This is distinct from the separately verified binary64 BasisPoint conversion of server integer area.

segmentHelper.formula: r=B-A,s=D-C,det=cross(r,s); if abs(det)<float32(1e-8), return false. Otherwise t=cross(C-A,s)/det and u=cross(C-A,r)/det; accept t,u in[0,1] and return A+t*r.
segmentHelper.parallelAndCollinear: Both parallel and collinear pairs are rejected by the determinant threshold; collinear overlap is not split by this helper.

callerEndpointFilter.rule: After helper succeeds, require EndpointEps<=t,u<=float32(1-EndpointEps). EndpointEps is9.999999747378752e-5 and upper bound0.9998999834060669. Thus endpoint-near crossings are excluded; equality to the actual float constants is included.

nodeMerge.rule: Find first existing node for which float32(dx*dx+dy*dy)<float32(eps*eps). Caller passes eps=0.5 in local mesh units; equality at squared distance0.25 does not merge. Otherwise append the new node.
nodeMerge.unitBoundary: This tolerance belongs to local display coordinates after RectTransform normalization; it must not be transplanted blindly into a normalized server area algorithm.

tinySplitEdges.rule: Split-edge squared lengths below float32(1e-8) are skipped. Equality to the threshold is retained.

floatAndDegenerateRules.zeroFace: Face selection rejects S==0; it does not quantize a face area into a gameplay percentage.
